# V_eta migration coverage ledger

*Generated by `tools/coverage.py` -- do NOT hand-edit; re-run after a schema or migrator change. One row per did_v1 SOURCE class, from BOTH v1 writers: the NDI production templates (read from NDI-matlab `origin/main`, not a lagging feature branch) AND the vhlab app/calculator classes that appear in real corpora but ship no NDI template (footprint = a bespoke migrator that consumes them). Post-v1 DID intermediate classes (zarr, directory, the `*_observation` leaves, ...) are V_eta TARGETS, not v1 sources, and are excluded. Each row shows the V_eta document class(es) the v1 class MIGRATES INTO (from the curated `V_eta_migration_targets.json`), its disposition, and its writer.*

**102 v1 source classes** (91 NDI/main + 11 vhlab app) | by V_eta disposition: consumed by migrator (no tombstone)=28, dissolved → subject=1, in_progress=19, persist=4, retire=48, test/demo fixture (non-production)=2 | 88 have a bespoke migrator.

**No-target census.** DENOMINATOR: 102 rows inspected; 8 name no target class of any kind. Across ALL 102 rows the recorded no-target dispositions are **3 dissolved** (signed, final -- note a dissolution is a fact about the DECISION, so a row can carry one while its migrator still emits the class today), **1 DISPUTED**, **4 signed passthroughs** whose decided target is the class itself, and **2 with NO TARGET AND NO DISSOLUTION RECORDED** (`epochclocktimes`, `imageStack_parameters`). Only the last is a missing record; the blank rows not otherwise accounted for are test/demo scaffolding or pre-V_zeta dissolutions, already labelled in the disposition column. A blank cell is no longer expressible: a row with no target must carry a transcribed sign-off saying so, or it renders as a gap.

**How much is built.** DENOMINATOR: 102 of 102 row(s) classified, 0 UNCLASSIFIABLE. **91 of 102 v1 source classes have something in the migration that CONSUMES them; 11 do not.** That rung has an answer on every row -- 0 unmeasured -- which is why it leads. Governance is NOT part of this ladder: whether a sign-off can be found for a class is reported in its own column and never caps a build stage.

**Completion ladder.** A class lands on EXACTLY ONE stage -- the highest rung for which every rung below it is satisfied -- so a rung that is `no` or `not measured` stops the climb even when a higher one holds. The stage is DERIVED from fields on the row; there is no list to hand-set. `not measured` is not `no`. Rungs 1 and 2 do not imply each other, so their order is a tie broken toward the FULLY MEASURED one -- putting the unread rung first would cap 72 rows below a fact this tool knows for certain.

| stage | what it means | classes AT this stage | rung satisfied on its own | yes / no / n/a / not measured |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 0 | source identified | 11 | 102 (by construction) | — |
| 1 | a migrator CONSUMES it | 64 | 91 | 91 / 11 / 0 / 0 |

| 4 | CORPUS-PROVEN | 0 | 0 | 0 / 0 / 0 / 102 |

**Capped, or untouched? DENOMINATOR: 102 classified row(s).** 4 are CAPPED -- a rung above their stage is satisfied while a lower one is unread or unmet -- and **5 are GENUINELY UNTOUCHED: no rung is satisfied at all** (`animalsubject`, `base`, `imageCollection`, `imageStack_parameters`, `mock`). A further 2 have nothing built while the rungs above them are `n/a` by a SIGNED DISSOLUTION (`stimulus_response`, `stimulus_response_scalar_parameters`) -- counted apart, because a settled class and an unexamined one must never be one figure. The untouched number is the honest floor. `highest rung satisfied on its own` is NOT a stage and must never be quoted as one; it exists so a capped row can say which rung holds above its cap.

**72 of 102 rows record NO TARGET CLASS**, which makes rungs 2 and 3 unreadable for them: `decided_targets` is empty, so rung 2 has nothing to look for in the built set and rung 3 has nothing to check an emission against. NOT evidence that no target exists. The signature join moves **0** of them, and that zero is structural, not a shortfall -- a TEAM-SIGN-OFF line signs a FAMILY, not a per-class target list. The join can say a class is decided; it cannot say WHAT it becomes. Naming a target from it would be inventing one.

**Stage 4 (CORPUS-PROVEN) is NOT MEASURED on all 102 rows** -- no corpus report root was supplied (pass --corpus-reports DIR or set V_ETA_CORPUS_REPORTS). It is not `no` and it is not skipped: "no corpus proved it" and "nobody looked" are different facts, and this container has no MATLAB and cannot download run artifacts. It is the only honest "done" measure this ledger has. WHAT WOULD LIGHT IT UP: a DID-matlab corpus run's `<corpus>-summary.json` reports reachable from this repo -- pass --corpus-reports DIR or set V_ETA_CORPUS_REPORTS. Each report must carry `source_census.by_class` (per v1 SOURCE class) plus `quarantine_count`, `fragment_count`, `reference_integrity.orphan_count` and `silent_loss.empty_required_dependency`.

**Anomalies: 4 across 4 class(es).** A rung satisfied above the stage a class reached. Not smoothed away and not promoted -- `over_failed` (4) means a lower rung has POSITIVE evidence against it, a real contradiction; `over_unmeasured` (0) means evidence exists above a hole in the record, which is a transcription job and not a build job. CONTRADICTIONS: `app` (stage 2), `ensemble` (stage 2), `projectvar` (stage 2), `stimulus_parameter_table` (stage 2).

**Governance -- can we PROVE the team agreed? A FLAG, NOT A STAGE, and never added to one.** DENOMINATOR: 102 row(s) classified. **39 signed** (7 checked transcription on the row, 32 derived from a signed family), **1 DISPUTED** (the record states two incompatible dispositions), **0 named by a family that carries no signature**, **62 with no signature this tool can find**. That last number is the absence of a FINDABLE signature and not evidence that no decision exists -- operating rule 3.

**The join, measured.** DENOMINATOR: 102 row(s) inspected; 40 reached by a signed decision family (40 on v1_class; 3 matched on the v1 name ONLY, 0 on the V_eta name ONLY). It joins on the SIGNATURE, never on family membership -- an unsigned family names classes too, and promoting them would break operating rule 4 with a lookup. It joins on the row's OWN identity (its v1 name or its V_eta class, matched EXACTLY, in both namespaces, with no normalisation), never on what its migrator emits.

| rows with no findable signature | cause |
|---:|---|
| 0 | a family names this class and that family is UNSIGNED |
| 36 | no family names this class; a SIGNED family names a class its migrator EMITS |
| 4 | no family names this class, and the row has no V_eta class and no target either |
| 22 | no family in FAMILIES names this class |

**Why the emitted-target rows are NOT joined.** Matching a row's emitted `targets` as well would move more rows, and most of them would arrive through one class: `session_relative_reference (time_reference)` ×32, `subject (subject)` ×3, `control_designation (stimulus)` ×1, `daqreader_epochdata_ingested (daq ingested payloads)` ×1. A signature on the time model decides the time model; it says nothing about whether the disposition of the class that happens to emit a time anchor is settled. The reach is counted here instead of taken.

**Where the signatures are. DENOMINATOR: 52 plan document(s) read (3 generated artifact(s) excluded, carrying 1 marker(s) between them -- a generated file quotes signatures, it does not hold them); 33 sign-off line(s) accepted, 0 rejected.** 23 of 23 decision families are signed.

**QUESTION FOR THE TEAM -- 5 signed tag(s) name no decision family**, so the signature reaches nothing this tool joins: `base naming` (V_eta_tenet_audit.md:516); `binding governance` (V_eta_tenet_audit.md:429); `dataseries_channel_map` (V_eta_go_forward_class_audit.md:222); `date dtype` (V_eta_tenet_audit.md:512); `epoch extent -- row #113` (V_eta_OPEN_WORK.md:2905). Whether each is a family that needs renaming, a family that needs creating, or a decision that belongs to no family is a TEAM call; mapping one onto a family it does not name would be recording a disposition.

THE SECOND PASS IS DORMANT AS OF 2026-08-12 AND EMITS NOTHING -- team decision (jess@walthamdatascience.com): the model is ONE statement per source document carrying an ARRAY of booleans against a TIME AXIS, and the team chose to WAIT for `axes[]` (#45, blocked on #32) rather than ship the 1->N one-statement-per-interval decomposition as an interim step. So `valid_interval` documents live on their v1 tombstone today and nothing downstream of them exists yet. `did2.convert.resolveValidIntervals` still RUNS as a census (`sources_seen` / `intervals_seen` measure the deferred work) and its decomposition logic is preserved behind `options.Decompose`, default FALSE. WHEN IT IS RE-ARMED the class it emits is `logical_observation` (renamed from `validity_observation` on 2026-08-12: the 32 `*_observation` data_types name a KIND OF VALUE and the SEMANTIC belongs in `subject_statement.variable`), plus the `relative_reference` each statement is anchored to (start = t0, duration = t1 - t0, clock de-encoded from clocktypestring). A batch pass and not a migrator for the same structural reason as resolveSessionAnchors: `relative_reference.relative_to` is REQUIRED and names the `epoch` DOCUMENT, whose id exists only after did2.convert.epochMint has minted it corpus-wide, and a single-document migrator holds an epoch STRING it cannot map to a document id. ⚠ ADDS, NEVER REMOVES -- and while DORMANT it adds nothing at all. The source document is KEPT under its v1 tombstone (nothing required, `element_id` optional), so a passthrough cannot trip mustBeNonEmpty or undeclaredField. NOT SIGNED: no TEAM-SIGN-OFF line exists, so the board keeps rendering this family as awaiting review. The 2026-08-11 'decision' was a QUESTION recorded as an answer (#103); the 2026-08-12 decisions are (a) the ARRAY model with a time axis is the target and (b) the classes are named `logical` / `logical_observation`, not `validity` / `validity_observation`. `sequence` is DELETED: v1's array-append order is invisible to its only consumer (tuning_response.m:253-256 indexes identifyvalidintervals's RETURN VALUE, and markgarbage.m:178-204 accumulates every row through a set union without indexing by position). OPEN SUB-QUESTION, deliberately not pre-empted: NDI's loadvalidinterval inherits a derived element's validity from its `underlying_element` (markgarbage.m:146-155), and whether V_eta re-derives that at query time or materialises it is a team call -- both remain buildable. ⚑ SCHEMA: 1 of 1 decided target class(es) present in the built set (`logical_observation`). MIGRATOR: does NOT emit them yet. | retire | ndi |
